en: Colored vintage postcard view across a body of water toward a dense historic waterfront cityscape. In the foreground are small rowing boats on a calm sea or strait. Along the shore stand piers with moored sailing ships and steamers, and a prominent mosque with a central dome and minarets slightly right of center. The hillside behind is filled with tightly packed buildings and additional minarets. Printed captions in red at the top identify the scene and publisher, and a watermark with a web address appears at the bottom.
